HNSW visited vectors: measured vs Lucene k·ln(n) vs our model

Each point is one query from acorn_off_all.csv, sampled evenly across graph sizes (about 1,500 per cell, equal share per size) so large graphs aren't swamped by small ones. Surfaces show each formula evaluated at the band's median selectivity and the selected M. Positive = a full scan is cheaper (true cost > filtered_docs). Green = correct (TP or TN), red = false positive (scanned when HNSW was cheaper), yellow = false negative (used HNSW when a scan was cheaper). Axes are linear. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom.
